cases.scope: Read-only: every arkTrigger volume has exactly one native component, arkCpntTrigger (vtable 0x1c5bae8; interfaces 0x1c5bbc8 at +0x20, 0x1c5ba98 at +0x40).

Pass: with coop_trigger_mirror on, the host walked into three script trigger volumes (and crossed others on the way) while the client stayed at the docks spawn ~80 m away; all 9 host-local script-trigger enter/exit events replayed natively in the client world for Emily's player (none missing/rejected); audio volumes were not mirrored; the Wall of Light tutorial trigger raised the native tutorial modal (logic 12) on both peers; the client HUD then showed the native Objective updated banner and HOSTILE TERRITORY indicator.

native.triggerHandler: 0x140779e00 arkCpntTrigger enter/exit (component, entity, enter): posts the trigger script event (FUN_1408848a0 with onEnter/onExit), once-trigger early-out (component+0xd0 and entity+0xd4&4), messages 0xd2/0xd3
native.registration: 0x140779980 registers arkCpntTrigger::OnTriggerEvent with the physics trigger system

findings: Confirmed runtime: replaying the native arkCpntTrigger enter/exit handler for the partner's own player advances the partner's mission script (tutorial modal, objective update, hostile territory) without the partner entering the volume.
Mirroring is limited to script_trigger* volumes (not hideout/noswim/audio volumes, which describe the local player's own position).
